name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey in motorsport began in his early twenties, fuelled by a lifelong fascination with Formula 1. He started as a junior mechanic at a small Belgian racing outfit, quickly demonstrating a keen eye for detail and a natural aptitude for understanding complex mechanical systems. His ambition led him to pursue a degree in Engineering, which he completed while continuing to work part-time in motorsport. 

Upon graduating, Jean-Pierre transitioned into team management, initially focusing on logistics and operations. His pragmatic approach and ability to streamline processes caught the attention of Racing Start Academy, who recruited him to oversee their junior driver program. He quickly rose through the ranks, becoming known for his data-driven decision-making and ability to foster a positive and collaborative team environment. Jean-Pierre believes in empowering his staff and nurturing young talent, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation within the team. He distinguishes himself with his quiet, analytical approach.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a slender build and an intense gaze, often seen analyzing data with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas or observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Drinks black coffee exclusively, no sugar or milk.
